# Visit

Discover the spaces, experiences, and amenities that make every visit to Scottsdale Arts memorable

![](https://scottsdaleartscdn-aachf7b8fzf8czhx.z03.azurefd.net/media/xshf3zdl/ccl-gif.gif)

## Our Campus

Scottsdale Arts’ campus at Civic Center is a vibrant destination where performances, exhibitions, and public art come together in the heart of Old Town. Home to Scottsdale Center for the Performing Arts, SMoCA, and Civic Center Live’s outdoor stages, the campus offers space to gather, connect, and experience creativity in many forms.

1. [Learn More](/visit/our-campus/ "Our Campus")

![](https://scottsdaleartscdn-aachf7b8fzf8czhx.z03.azurefd.net/media/jhipivsx/imgi_44_jacknife-01.jpg)

## Enhance Your Visit

Make the most of your time in Old Town Scottsdale with handpicked recommendations for local dining, shopping, and cultural experiences. Whether you're planning a pre-show dinner, a weekend stay, or just exploring the neighborhood, our community partners offer exclusive deals and welcoming spaces to round out your visit.

1. [Learn More](/visit/enhance-your-visit/ "Enhance Your Visit")

![](https://scottsdaleartscdn-aachf7b8fzf8czhx.z03.azurefd.net/media/xqshv02f/25-scpa-evergreen-shop.jpg)

## Shop

Discover one-of-a-kind gifts, art-inspired merchandise, and locally made treasures at our two retail stores located at the Center and SMoCA. Whether you're browsing in person or shopping online, every purchase supports the arts in Scottsdale.

1. [Learn More](/visit/shop/ "Shop")

![](https://scottsdaleartscdn-aachf7b8fzf8czhx.z03.azurefd.net/media/1jun42wx/civic-center-central-lawn.png)

## Venue Rentals

Host your next event in one of Scottsdale Arts' unforgettable venues. From elegant indoor spaces to scenic outdoor stages, our campus offers flexible settings for performances, private celebrations, corporate events, and more. Let our team help you create a seamless and memorable experience.

1. [Learn More](/visit/venue-rentals/ "Venue Rentals")
